dock.text: A rickety plank dock juts into a flooded lot, half a dozen lashed-together hulls bobbing beside it. {{builder_name}} is up to their elbows in scrap cord, not looking up. 'You want across, or you want to sink. I can only really help with one of those.'

choices.label: Ask how the rafts are built.

the_lashing.text: 'Scrap wood, lashed tight, tar the seams if you've got it.' {{builder_name}} taps the nearest hull. 'Won't win a race. Won't sink either, mostly. Floats you over anything wet like it was dry ground.'

splinter.text: A jagged plank end catches your palm before you can pull back.
